definition: Irfan Aziz Essa is a professor in the School of Interactive Computing of the College of Computing, and adjunct professor in the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech).
details: He is an associate dean in Georgia Tech's College of Computing and the director of the new Interdisciplinary Research Center for Machine Learning at Georgia Tech (ML@GT).
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. That pixel-to-meaning climb is Irfan Essa.
